rules: Explicit new user/root request overrides prior authority for the historical nRF24PA32B/2Mbps/0dBm TX and RX3/5 batches, now superseded by the verified5/5 batch; delete their ten RAW as whole conditions, preserve all interpreted files.
Only existing .csv.gz and .ppk2.bin RAW are candidates. Metadata, logs, summaries, exports, code and ZIP archives are preserved.
Explicit accepted_result, valid independent attempts and authoritative coverage take precedence over failure indications.
Parent campaign stopped/failed/incomplete does not cause deletion of its independently accepted lots.
RX-missing alone never causes deletion: intentional loss/control captures and complete interpreted data are preserved.
Unknown provenance preserves data by default. No RAW decompression, hashes or hardware access performed.
